name: Torii
summary: Torii is a SaaS management platform that finds apps through several sources at once, including single sign-on, finance data, direct integrations and a browser extension. It tracks license use against assignments and builds a renewal view from contract data. Pricing is not published and starts from a demo request.

facts.text: Torii says discovery runs continuously and draws on identity provider and SSO data, finance and expense data, direct integrations and a browser extension.
Torii says it flags inactive, duplicate and abandoned seats and can reclaim them through policies, and that it keeps a ledger of every license assignment and change.
Torii lists auto-alerts for renewals and auto-renew clauses, plus a shared renewal calendar.
Torii's pricing page names three offerings, IGA, SMP (app discovery, savings and renewals) and AI Management, and shows no prices.

plans.name: SMP (app discovery, savings and renewals)
plans.notes: No price published. The page sends buyers to a demo request.
